conditions: 6 AM—Rise and shine! The big-mountain beach party continues into the first weekend of spring, turning Rendezvous Mountain into a fascinating plaything. Photons will fall through partly cloudy skies before refracting from the landscape and landing squarely in the back of your eyes. Take it all in, but remember to dress fairly slim, because temperatures will zoom well into the 40s at the summit as they approach the mid-60s down in Teton Village. Light-to-moderate west winds will do what they can to keep you cool as they breeze through in the 10 to 30 mph range. Despite the bright sunlight, your pupils will over-dilate, attempting to record the extraordinary sight when you roll the next knoll and your satiated soul takes flight. -Lege
